How to use a cold phone
A phone that never goes online holds the keys; the one with internet only carries encrypted text.

The cold phone holds your identities and contacts and never goes online. The phone with internet keeps no keys: it only carries encrypted text.

To send: on the cold phone, open the writing area, tap the lock, write and encrypt, then tap "Show as a QR code". On the phone with internet, tap the QR button on the keyboard, scan the code and insert the message in the chat.

To read: on the phone with internet, copy the encrypted message, tap the QR button and show it as a QR code. On the cold phone, open the writing area, tap the QR button and scan the code. The message only appears on the cold phone.

Never type a secret on the phone with internet. Keep the cold phone in airplane mode, with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth off, and turn on the QR code button on the phone with internet; in the writing area of the cold phone it is always there. A message goes as a loop of small codes and can have up to %d letters.
